title: ABDM participation scope
definition: No identified local application-code gap remains against the frozen SAHA-083 scope; formal acceptance, partner onboarding, sandbox credentials, facility registry verification, independent review, CI, merge and deployment remain separate.
implementation: Records explicit approved ABDM roles and operations per deployment, including the complete declared role vocabulary for ABHA, Scan and Share, HIP, HIU, consented exchange and NHCX.
Binds the declaration to environment, facility, a non-secret client credential reference, active responsible organisation owner and owner evidence.
Refuses role-operation mismatches, inactive or non-owner responsibility, undeclared operations, unapproved modules and stale concurrent configuration writes before side effects.
Shows the resulting participation declaration in administration and preserves the existing local-mock-only boundary.

verification.coverage: positive, refusal, authorization, no-side-effect, stale-write race

verification.note: Production build completed; existing chunk-size advisory only.
